test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P and Q are inversely proportional to each other and P is 10, when Q is 6. What will be the value of Q when P is 15?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For inverse proportion: P₁ × Q₁ = P₂ × Q₂

Product must remain constant: 10 × 6 = 60

Now, 15 × Q = 60

Q = 60 ÷ 15 = 4

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial P (P₁) = 10

Initial Q (Q₁) = 6

New P (P₂) = 15

**Formula Used:**

In inverse proportion, P ∝ 1/Q ⇒ P × Q = k (Constant)

 
 Case 1
 P = 10
 Q = 6
 
 →
 
 
 Case 2
 P = 15
 Q = ?
 
 Product (P × Q) remains Constant = 60

**Calculations:**

⇒ P₁ × Q₁ = k

⇒ 10 × 6 = 60

⇒ Now, P₂ × Q₂ = 60

⇒ 15 × Q₂ = 60

⇒ Q₂ = 60 ÷ 15

⇒ Q₂ = 4

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are in direct proportion if an increase in one leads to a proportional increase in the other (y/x = k or y₁/x₁ = y₂/x₂).

Inverse Proportion

Two quantities are in inverse proportion if an increase in one leads to a proportional decrease in the other (xy = k or x₁y₁ = x₂y₂).

Proportionality Constant

The value k is known as the constant of proportionality, which relates the two variables in any state of the relationship.</p
